Name: Pierre Sells Forage
Author: Lekshi
Description:
[b]Pierre finally approve abigail to go in adventure and collect forage items for his business.

[/b]Pierre now sells forage. This mod currently includes SVE and Ridgeside Village Forage but still works without SVE and Ridgeside Village. If im missing something, let me know.

-Items that has a label of Fruits and Flowers that could be pick up/forage in the game is included.

Downloads.Description: Make sure you have Shop Tile Framework for this mod to work.
